description: This source file defines functions for configuring a trigger shape for a BMW engine, specifically for a Mini Cooper. It contains an inline helper function to add trigger events and a function to set up the trigger shape with specific timing events and constraints.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: A class representing the shape of engine trigger signals, including methods to add events and properties for synchronization.

methods.name: addPair
methods.description: Inline helper function that adds a pair of trigger events (rising and falling edges) at specified intervals to the TriggerShape.

methods.name: configureMiniCooperTriggerShape
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape for a Mini Cooper engine, defining timing events and constraints specific to that engine's trigger pattern.
